project_type: Three.js/TypeScript browser game with React UI (Vite + Tailwind)
test_framework: No test framework configured - validation via build only
verification_instructions: Run TypeScript type check (npx tsc --noEmit) and Vite build (npx vite build) to ensure no errors.
environment_constraints: node_modules already installed. No Docker daemon needed. Browser game validated via tsc + vite build.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code patterns.
key_patterns: InventorySystem is a class with slots array, state change callbacks, drag-drop methods. EditorApp.tsx renders all playtest UI as a single large component with React state. Combat.ts manages HP, damage, items. ItemDefs.ts defines items with id/name/icon/type/description/stackable/maxStack/rarity/category. PlaytestMode.ts orchestrates all game systems in playtest. Inventory currently uses 16 slots (4x4). Hotbar shows first 4 slots. Inventory opens with Q key. Items have types: weapon/melee/tool/consumable/ammo. Tab key is not currently used.
directory_structure: JailBreak-1.2/src/game/ - game systems (Combat, Inventory, Hands, Weapon, etc). JailBreak-1.2/src/editor/ - PlaytestMode and map editor. JailBreak-1.2/src/components/ - React UI components. JailBreak-1.2/src/EditorApp.tsx - main React component with all playtest UI rendering.
